guidetextdraw._value:
This worksheet provides staff members with a tool to supply their supervisors or evaluator* with job-related performance input before a performance evaluation is developed. This input may be provided in other ways (such as memo or e-mail). Staff members are not required to provide written pre-performance evaluation input**. Written pre-performance evaluation input is intended to enhance one-on-one communications before the performance evaluation is developed. This written information should not be considered a substitute for interactive, in-person, communications.

In order to meet campus performance evaluation deadlines, a staff member's supervisor or evaluator should receive written pre-performance evaluation input on or before the date specified in the Performance Evaluation Calendar:
